dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Well, what's passed has passed, I say.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Life isn't all sweet fruit juice. It also needs some bitter alcohol. These incidents will also become part of our experience.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Rather than ask how this could happen, we should look forward to the future. Accepting the bitter with the sweet is how adults do things.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Once you're ready for the bitter, I'll pour you a special brew.
